selection.role: selected qualification candidate for a later implementation decision
rationale: The user explicitly selected an exact commit pin rather than waiting for infrequent tagged releases.
The candidate is native Go in the same BSD-3-Clause Gonum module family as the Louvain comparator.
Both candidates passed identical 3+1 deterministic schedules and produced the same canonical output on the admitted retained fixture.
The selection establishes candidate preference, not algorithmic superiority or production adoption.

non_entailments: No tested output establishes semantic feature, business, service, ownership, or organizational boundaries.
One fixture does not establish quality superiority, general stability, portability beyond the retained runtime, or complete resource behavior.
This comparison does not authorize production implementation or dependency adoption.
claim_ceiling: A-02 compares exactly the two evaluated candidates and records the selected candidate. It does not satisfy A-03 through A-10 or authorize implementation.
